title: Swedish regions, actual monthly employment
exposure_kind: regional THAIE quintiles, not occupational quintiles
note: All occupations within each county. Monthly BAS counts and frozen 2022 workplace-based employee occupation weights are different statistical populations. Employee weights are ages 16–64; monthly employment includes broader employed persons ages 20–64. The exact monthly table geography convention remains to be confirmed. Residence-based SSYK3 sensitivity changes 2 of 21 quintiles relative to workplace SSYK3; it is not a fully aligned replacement. Partial mapped occupation coverage is not full workforce coverage. Unadjusted for seasonality. November 2022 = 100. Exact requested ages are unavailable.
